title: SYDKYK employee handbook
text:
Company and workforce
SYDKYK is a Philippines-based business process and digital services company with a workforce of 4,000 across Makati, Quezon City, Cebu and Davao. Assigned office populations are Makati 1,600, Quezon City 800, Cebu 1,000 and Davao 600, including employees with remote or hybrid arrangements. Our departments include Operations, Customer Success, Engineering, IT, HR, Finance, Sales and Workplace Services. This handbook explains how employees access company services and meet their workplace responsibilities.

title: SYDKYK employee handbook
text:
Organization and working arrangements
Workday is the system of record for employment details, department, manager, office and cost center. Employees should check their own record and request corrections through People Operations. Sprout Solutions manages leave requests, balances and approval status. ADP holds payroll records and payslips. Where information differs between systems, the responsible service owner must investigate before a related transaction proceeds.
The standard day shift runs Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00, with a one-hour unpaid meal break. Some Operations teams work assigned night shifts. Your approved schedule determines working days and leave duration. Times in company communications are Philippine time unless another timezone is stated. Consult the approved company calendar and applicable holiday announcements before making plans.

title: SYDKYK employee handbook
text:
Service ownership
People Operations owns employment records and letters. Payroll owns pay inquiries and ADP record corrections. Finance owns expenses and reimbursement processing. IT owns identity, applications and equipment. Workplace Services owns office access, bookings and facilities. Your manager approves only matters within their current authority. Delegation must be formally recorded with an effective period and scope.

title: SYDKYK employee handbook
text:
Requesting support
Use SYDKYK employee services to ask a policy question or prepare a request. Review the dates, amount, supporting information and approvers before confirming submission. A request reference confirms receipt; it does not mean the request is approved or fulfilled. Missing information will be returned for clarification. Exceptions require the designated policy owner's review. Service targets begin when complete information is received and are not guaranteed completion dates.

title: SYDKYK employee handbook
text:
Employee responsibilities
Keep your employment details current, protect company information, report lost equipment promptly and treat colleagues respectfully. Never share passwords, MFA codes or recovery credentials in chat. Submit personal evidence, medical information and payroll banking information only through the approved secure channel. Managers must protect confidential information and avoid accessing records unrelated to their responsibilities.

title: SYDKYK employee handbook
text:
Document authority
Use this handbook for general guidance and the current domain policy for detailed rules. Report conflicting instructions to the relevant policy owner rather than choosing a preferred interpretation. Questions about legal entitlements or regulatory requirements must be referred to People Operations, Payroll or Legal for verified guidance. Company policies do not replace applicable law.

title: Leave attendance and work arrangements
text:
Company leave rules
Regular full-time employees receive an annual company vacation allocation of 15 working days, sick allocation of 10 working days and emergency allocation of 3 working days. These company benefits do not replace other applicable statutory or protected leave. People Operations confirms eligibility for other employment types and leave categories.
Submit vacation requests in Sprout Solutions at least five scheduled working days before the proposed start date. Shorter notice requires manager and People Operations exception review. A vacation reason is optional. Do not include a diagnosis in ordinary chat. If medical evidence is required, People Operations will provide a restricted submission route.

title: Leave attendance and work arrangements
text:
Balance and duration
Sprout Solutions is the source for current leave balances and request status. Available leave equals allocation plus approved adjustments minus taken days, approved future days and pending reserved days. A submitted request reserves the requested days. Approval converts that reservation into approved future leave without a second deduction. Rejection or withdrawal releases the reservation. Cancellation of approved leave requires manager approval before the balance is restored.
Duration follows the employee's approved schedule and applicable company calendar. A full scheduled day is 1.0 day and a half day is 0.5 day. Overlapping active leave requests are not permitted. Requests exceeding available paid leave must be discussed with People Operations; they are not automatically converted to unpaid leave.

title: Leave attendance and work arrangements
text:
Approvals and status
Review leave type, dates, chargeable days, balance impact and manager before submission. The assigned manager approves or rejects the request in Sprout Solutions. The approval target is two business days. A pending request is not approved leave. Managers cannot approve their own requests; approval moves to their manager or another authorized reviewer.
Approved leave must be recorded successfully in Sprout Solutions before related calendar updates are confirmed. Changes to dates or leave type require fresh review. If a reporting relationship or policy changes while a request is pending, the appropriate approver and rules must be checked again.

title: Leave attendance and work arrangements
text:
Attendance and schedules
A missing punch is an attendance exception to investigate, not proof of absence. Provide the date, expected shift, claimed actual hours and reason. Manager approval of a correction creates a Payroll review where the pay period is closed. Payroll confirms any ADP adjustment; attendance approval alone does not promise a pay reversal.
Overtime requires manager authorization and validated time records. People Operations and Payroll determine applicable treatment. Shift changes, remote-work arrangements and location changes require a proposed effective date and manager and People Operations approval, with IT or Workplace tasks where needed.

title: Leave attendance and work arrangements
text:
Examples
An employee with 12.0 available vacation days requesting three scheduled days would have 9.0 available while the request is reserved. An employee with 1.0 day available cannot submit the same three-day request as fully paid vacation. People Operations can discuss alternatives without changing the requested leave category automatically.

title: Employment documents and employee records
text:
Certificate of employment
Employees may request a certificate of employment through People Operations for a stated purpose. Provide the purpose, addressee where needed and whether compensation details are requested. The default certificate contains employee name, position, start date and current employment status as of the issue date. It excludes compensation, home address, government identifiers and disciplinary information.
Workday provides the employment record used to prepare the certificate. The employee reviews the proposed details and People Operations verifies and authorizes issuance. A compensation-inclusive certificate also requires Payroll review against the approved ADP record. The service target is three business days after a complete request is received. A prepared draft is not an issued certificate.

title: Employment documents and employee records
text:
Corrections and records
Display-name, contact-preference, legal-name, address and emergency-contact corrections must be submitted through the appropriate employee-record request. People Operations confirms required evidence and provides a secure upload route. Payroll banking changes require separate secure verification; account numbers must not be supplied in general chat.
Approved changes are recorded in Workday with the effective date and reviewer. Relevant downstream systems are updated through the responsible team. Employees receive confirmation only after the record update is completed. An incomplete downstream update remains visible as an outstanding task.

title: Employment documents and employee records
text:
Record visibility
Employees may view their own employment details. Managers may view authorized business contact, role, office and workflow information for current direct reports. A reporting relationship does not automatically grant access to personal documents, compensation or employee-relations records. People Operations and Payroll access is limited to assigned responsibilities.
Requests for another employee's certificate or payslip must follow an authorized verification process. Corrections to an issued document create a new version and revoke access to the superseded copy.

title: Employment documents and employee records
text:
Employment verification and letters
External employment verification requires People Operations review of the request, recipient and permitted disclosure. Service and experience letters are checked against approved employment and separation records. Certificates must use the approved template and authorized signatory. Documents must not be sent to an external recipient without the required employee authorization and release approval.

title: Employment documents and employee records
text:
Certificate template
CERTIFICATE OF EMPLOYMENT
This is to certify that [employee name], employee number [employee ID], is employed by SYDKYK as [position] from [start date] and is recorded as [employment status] as of [issue date]. This certificate is issued at the employee's request for [purpose]. Compensation details are excluded unless separately approved.
Prepared by People Operations. Authorized signatory and issuance reference to be completed only after verification.

title: Payroll benefits and compensation service guide
text:
Payroll inquiries
ADP is SYDKYK's payroll system. Payroll is scheduled twice monthly, on the 15th and last calendar day, with a prior company working-day fallback. Attendance cutoffs are the 10th and 25th at 18:00 Philippine time. Payroll reviews approved changes and any closed-period adjustments before they enter a later pay run.
Employees may request their own payslip and an explanation of its recorded line items. An explanation must distinguish posted amounts from estimates or pending corrections. Statutory deduction, tax, contribution, premium and 13th-month pay questions must be referred to Payroll for verified calculations. Do not treat a general policy answer as a payroll calculation.

title: Payroll benefits and compensation service guide
text:
Discrepancy handling
Identify the pay period and disputed item when raising an inquiry. Payroll may compare the employee's ADP payslip with authorized attendance and leave information, including Sprout Solutions leave records. The acknowledgment target is two business days. Manager approval of an attendance correction does not by itself authorize an ADP adjustment or guarantee a refund.
Payroll confirms the investigation outcome, adjustment period and record reference where applicable. No adjustment is complete until the payroll record has been updated and checked. Personal banking information and supporting evidence must use Payroll's secure verification process.

title: Payroll benefits and compensation service guide
text:
Benefits
The company health plan provides an annual medical limit of PHP 150,000 per eligible regular employee, subject to the applicable plan terms and Benefits confirmation. Dependent enrollment requires eligibility review and either a qualifying event or an enrollment window. The annual enrollment window is November 1 to 30, 2026.
Provide the relationship category and event date. Submit identity or medical evidence only through the restricted Benefits channel. Coverage is confirmed only after Benefits has validated eligibility and received the insurer's acknowledgment. A request received is not confirmation of coverage.

title: Payroll benefits and compensation service guide
text:
Compensation and one time payments
Managers may propose merit adjustments, spot awards, referral payouts or relocation allowances for current direct reports. Each proposal requires employee ID, purpose, amount, currency, cost center and effective date. People Operations and Finance review the proposal; Payroll records the approved instruction in ADP.
Access to compensation is restricted. Managers may not use the general employee-service channel to obtain salary history or another employee's payslip. Promotions, demotions and adverse employment actions require authorized human decisions and cannot be decided by an assistant.

title: Payroll benefits and compensation service guide
text:
Sensitive answers
Do not disclose another person's pay, medical information or private benefit evidence. Requests outside the employee's authorized scope must be referred to the appropriate service owner. Employees may ask for clarification or correction without being promised a particular financial outcome.

title: Employee lifecycle and talent operations
text:
Preboarding and onboarding
An approved hire record in Workday starts an onboarding checklist tied to employee ID, start date, manager and office. Before Day 1, People Operations checks record completeness and agreement acknowledgment, IT prepares identity and equipment, and Workplace Services prepares office access. Personal identifiers and agreements must be handled through approved secure channels.
Day 1 covers welcome, orientation and access review. Week 1 includes security and job-specific training. Month 1 includes a manager check-in. Days 60 to 90 include scheduled People Operations and manager reviews where applicable. A checklist records operational readiness; it is not an employment-performance assessment. Pending required tasks remain visible and prevent a readiness confirmation.

title: Employee lifecycle and talent operations
text:
Transfers and position changes
Provide proposed department, receiving manager, office, title and effective date. People Operations verifies the receiving position and manager. Current and receiving managers review the change. Compensation changes are reviewed separately by Payroll and Finance.
After approval, People Operations updates Workday. Leave ownership and approver changes are checked in Sprout Solutions, and approved payroll-impacting instructions are referred to Payroll for ADP processing. IT and Workplace Services complete access, equipment and location tasks. Partial completion must be reported by task; the overall move is not complete while required actions remain open.
Promotions and demotions require human review and an authorized decision. A reporting change does not grant access to historic restricted employee-relations records.

title: Employee lifecycle and talent operations
text:
Performance and learning
Employees may view their own review deadlines and assigned tasks. Managers may view only the direct-report review information permitted for the relevant process. Self and peer assessment content remains confidential to authorized participants. Course requests require a course ID and session choice; full sessions use a waitlist. Training completion and certification renewal must be based on verified records.

title: Employee lifecycle and talent operations
text:
Requisitions and employee groups
A headcount requisition includes position, cost center, business reason, proposed headcount and budget owner. People Operations and Finance approve it before recruitment begins. Employee resource groups publish approved descriptions; participation is voluntary and membership access is restricted.

title: Employee lifecycle and talent operations
text:
Separation and clearance
An employee may prepare a resignation request with a proposed last working day for discussion with People Operations. Submission requires explicit employee confirmation and receipt acknowledgment. People Operations determines the required notice, effective dates and applicable obligations with Legal where needed. Termination and retirement decisions remain with authorized human decision makers.
An approved separation checklist coordinates handover, asset return, access revocation, expense reconciliation and clearance. Workday records the approved employment change; Payroll reviews final settlement through ADP. Outstanding equipment does not automatically authorize withholding pay. Former employee requests require a separately verified secure channel.

title: Code of conduct and employee concerns
text:
Expected behavior
SYDKYK expects employees to treat colleagues respectfully, protect confidential information, report business transactions honestly and use company resources responsibly. Harassment, discrimination, retaliation, falsification and threats must be referred for appropriate human review. A concern or allegation is not a finding of misconduct.

title: Code of conduct and employee concerns
text:
Conflicts gifts and data
Disclose potential conflicts to Employee Relations before taking part in a related procurement, hiring or other business decision. The internal gift-review threshold is PHP 1,000 per item. Cash and cash equivalents always require review. Do not share customer or employee information through an unapproved public service. Suspected data exposure must be reported through the Security process in IT-002.

title: Code of conduct and employee concerns
text:
Reporting a concern
Employees may use the confidential Employee Relations intake to report a concern. Provide a brief factual summary, approximate date and safe contact preference. Sensitive details and evidence should be supplied only through the restricted case channel. Employee Relations will explain who may review the report; absolute secrecy or a particular outcome cannot be promised.
Concerns involving the employee's manager must be routed outside that manager's review chain. Ordinary concerns have a one-business-day acknowledgment target. Immediate safety concerns require on-site human assistance and appropriate emergency services.

title: Code of conduct and employee concerns
text:
Fair review
Employee Relations assigns a reviewer, checks conflicts and considers relevant information and responses. Summaries must separate reported facts, disputed points and unknown information. Reviewers must not presume intent or guilt. Only authorized human decision makers may determine findings or employment outcomes.

title: Code of conduct and employee concerns
text:
Confidentiality and retaliation
Case details are available only to assigned reviewers and other specifically authorized participants. A system-administration role alone does not grant case-content access. Requests to identify a reporter or disclose another person's disciplinary status must be refused unless authorized through the proper process. Retaliation concerns must be referred to Employee Relations.

title: Code of conduct and employee concerns
text:
Employee acknowledgment
Acknowledgment records that the employee received and acknowledged a document. It does not establish agreement with allegations or waive employee rights. ER-001 governs restricted preparation and review of notices to explain. Employees seeking help with a notice should contact the assigned Employee Relations reviewer.

title: Notice to explain preparation and review procedure
text:
Scope and review responsibility
This procedure governs the preparation and review of a notice requesting an employee's explanation. Employee Relations and Legal must confirm applicable requirements, wording, response time, service arrangements and employee rights for the specific matter. A notice requests information; it is not a finding of misconduct or a disciplinary decision.

title: Notice to explain preparation and review procedure
text:
Authorization and intake
Only an assigned Employee Relations reviewer may prepare or access a case-specific draft. Required inputs include case ID, assigned reviewer, incident summary, relevant dates, evidence references, potentially relevant policy provisions and any response already provided. Missing facts must be marked unverified. General manager authority does not grant access to restricted case files.

title: Notice to explain preparation and review procedure
text:
Draft review steps
Separate reported facts, disputed points and unknown information. Reference evidence by record ID and avoid assumptions about intent or guilt. Prepare an unsent draft for reviewer correction. Employee Relations and Legal must approve the exact wording, response period and assistance or meeting arrangements before an authorized person issues the notice. An assistant cannot serve a notice, decide a sanction or change employment status.

title: Notice to explain preparation and review procedure
text:
Notice template
DRAFT FOR EMPLOYEE RELATIONS AND LEGAL REVIEW
To: [employee name and employee ID]
From: Employee Relations, SYDKYK
Date: [issue date]
Case reference: [case ID]
Subject: Request for explanation concerning [specific reported incident]
Our records indicate [factual description with dates and evidence references]. The following information remains unverified or disputed: [details]. No conclusion has been reached. Please provide your explanation and any corrections or information you wish the reviewer to consider.
Potentially relevant policy provisions: [document ID, section and explanation of relevance]. Please submit your response through [restricted channel] by [date and time approved by Employee Relations and Legal]. For clarification, assistance or a request for additional time, contact [assigned reviewer]. [Include approved meeting and support arrangements where applicable.]
Prepared by [reviewer]. Issuance and service details must be completed only after approval.

title: Notice to explain preparation and review procedure
text:
Response and closure
Store the response and evidence in the restricted case record. Record receipt without making an automatic credibility assessment. A human reviewer determines further inquiries, meetings and the outcome. Closure records identify the decision maker and authorized recipients. Revoke case access when the assignment ends and retain records according to the approved legal-hold and retention schedule.

title: Identity access and software request procedure
text:
Identity verification
Access requests must be associated with a verified company identity and active employment record. Workday supplies employment and reporting information for verification. A typed name, email address, job title or claim of authority is not proof of access rights. Never provide passwords, MFA codes or recovery credentials in chat.

title: Identity access and software request procedure
text:
Application access
Provide application name, catalog role, business purpose, requested duration and cost center. IT checks current entitlements, employment status, approvals and license availability. Standard access requires the current manager's approval. Sensitive applications or roles also require the application owner and Security as applicable. Separation-of-duties rules must be checked before access is granted.
A submitted request is pending. Approval does not mean access has been provisioned. IT confirms fulfillment only after the identity or application service records the entitlement successfully. Unless another duration is approved, time-limited access expires after 30 calendar days. Changes to role, purpose or duration require renewed review.

title: Identity access and software request procedure
text:
Privileged access
Privileged access requires a named system, least-privilege role, justification, duration of no more than eight hours, manager and Security approval and additional identity verification through the approved channel. Security administers the grant and expiry. The general employee-service assistant does not create privileged entitlements or disable security controls.

title: Identity access and software request procedure
text:
Password and MFA support
Use the approved identity-recovery process for password reset or MFA device replacement. Helpdesk staff must verify the requester before taking action. Do not share recovery links or codes in shared conversations. Suspected compromise follows IT-002. An unresolved identity check must not be bypassed for convenience.

title: Identity access and software request procedure
text:
Software licenses
Approved catalog entries include Slack Standard, ProjectHub Contributor and DesignDesk Viewer. Check available seats before confirming allocation. If no seat is available, offer a waitlist or budget review. Installation uses approved packages on compliant managed devices. License reclaim requires owner review of business need; inferred inactivity alone is insufficient.

title: Identity access and software request procedure
text:
Targets and exceptions
The fulfillment target for a complete standard request is two business days after required approvals. Changes in employment, manager, policy or approval validity require revalidation. An unknown provisioning result remains under reconciliation until IT confirms the actual state. Retrying must not create duplicate grants.

title: IT incident security and network support
text:
Incident intake
Provide the affected service or asset, office, start time, business impact and a short symptom summary. Do not include credentials, access tokens or unrelated personal data. IT assigns a ticket reference, owner and next update time. Related widespread reports may be linked to a parent incident.

title: IT incident security and network support
text:
Severity and service targets
P1 covers suspected active security compromise or a broad critical-service outage, with a 15-minute acknowledgment target around the clock. P2 covers an employee blocked from critical work, with a one-business-hour acknowledgment target. P3 covers degraded service, with a four-business-hour target. P4 covers routine requests, with a one-business-day target. These are acknowledgment targets, not promised resolution times. Human support confirms the severity and response.

title: IT incident security and network support
text:
Phishing and lost devices
Stop interacting with a suspected phishing message and report it through the approved secure channel. Do not open suspicious attachments or provide credentials for investigation. For a lost device, provide its asset tag if known, approximate time of loss and whether company information may be affected. Security determines containment, device-lock or other authorized actions and confirms completion through the incident record.

title: IT incident security and network support
text:
VPN and connectivity
Check the service-status notice before troubleshooting. Establish whether the issue affects one device or an office. Safe checks include confirming internet connectivity, restarting the approved client and checking device time. Do not disable endpoint protection, bypass certificate warnings or install unapproved networking tools. Repeated failures should be escalated with sanitized diagnostics.

title: IT incident security and network support
text:
Email and collaboration
Mailbox and calendar issues require a service ticket. Distribution-list membership changes need the list owner's approval. External members require Security review. Shared-mailbox access requires manager and mailbox-owner approval. Membership in a chat channel does not establish permission to underlying files or employee information.

title: IT incident security and network support
text:
Handoff and notifications
A handoff contains the permitted summary, affected service, ticket ID, urgency, checks completed and evidence references. It excludes credentials and unrelated HR history. Security details are shared only with authorized recipients. Employees receive a status update only when supported by the incident record; a request received is not confirmation that containment has occurred.

title: Devices assets and endpoint management
text:
Standard equipment
The standard employee kit includes one managed laptop, charger and headset. A monitor or nonstandard equipment requires manager approval. IT records asset tag, custodian, office, warranty and status in the asset register. Allocation depends on available stock and approved business need.

title: Devices assets and endpoint management
text:
Device issue and replacement
Provide asset tag and symptom description. IT diagnoses the issue through an approved support route. Repair or replacement review considers condition, warranty, stock, delivery office and cost. A manager approves nonstandard expenditure and IT approves allocation. Handover records the employee's acknowledgment and the asset state; ticket submission alone does not confirm delivery.

title: Devices assets and endpoint management
text:
Asset custody
Report damaged or missing equipment promptly. Do not transfer custody without an IT-recorded handover. Incomplete records are discrepancies requiring review, not evidence of wrongdoing. IT verifies the parties and corrects records where appropriate. Asset-return status does not automatically determine final pay or employment outcome.

title: Devices assets and endpoint management
text:
Onboarding and offboarding
IT tasks follow People Operations-approved Workday start dates, employment changes and separation instructions. Identity and equipment may be prepared before the start date, but usable access is confirmed only after activation and required approvals. Revocation uses the authorized effective timestamp. Each system's completion status remains visible until all required actions are confirmed.

title: Devices assets and endpoint management
text:
Endpoint compliance
Compliance states are Compliant, Needs update and Unknown. Approved endpoint tools provide the evidence for encryption, updates, security alerts and remediation. A support response must not claim a device is secured or repaired without a verified result. Remediation requiring user involvement is recorded as pending until completed.

title: Devices assets and endpoint management
text:
Proactive reviews
IT may flag a warranty nearing expiry or propose a license review based on authorized asset and usage records. The owner confirms business need before replacement or reclamation. Proactive service checks follow the same permissions and review requirements as employee requests and must not be used for covert employee monitoring.

title: Expenses reimbursements and business travel
text:
Expense rules
Expense claims must include business purpose, transaction date, amount, currency, category, cost center and an itemized receipt. Submit within 30 calendar days of the expense date. Personal expenses are ineligible. Alcohol and entertainment require explicit Finance exception review. Foreign-currency claims require a documented rate source and Finance validation.
Domestic travel caps are PHP 800 per person per day for meals, PHP 4,000 per hotel night and PHP 1,500 per day for local transport. These are internal spending limits, not tax thresholds. Amounts above a cap require Finance exception review. Claims must not be silently reduced or treated as a misconduct finding solely because they exceed a limit.

title: Expenses reimbursements and business travel
text:
Approval path
Claims up to PHP 5,000 require the employee's manager and Finance validation. Claims above PHP 5,000 also require the cost-center budget owner. Self-approval is prohibited. Finance checks receipt details, date, category, eligibility and possible duplicates. A matching receipt, date and amount indicates a possible duplicate for review, not proof of wrongdoing.

title: Expenses reimbursements and business travel
text:
Submission and payout
Review all extracted receipt fields before confirming submission. Approved claims are scheduled for the next eligible weekly payment batch, subject to Finance validation and processing cutoffs. Received, approved, scheduled and paid are distinct statuses. A paid status requires a confirmed payment reference; approval alone does not establish that funds were transferred.
Payment and bank-account information must use approved secure Finance channels. Employee payroll enquiries and any payroll-related adjustment are handled by Payroll through ADP. Do not assume an expense reimbursement has been included in ADP unless Payroll confirms that route for the specific claim.
Rejected claims include a reason and a resubmission route. If processing status is unknown, Finance reconciles the existing request before another payment attempt is authorized. Repeated submission must not create a second reimbursement.

title: Expenses reimbursements and business travel
text:
Worked examples
A PHP 1,250 local-transport expense for one day is within the PHP 1,500 cap and requires manager and Finance review. A PHP 6,500 claim additionally requires the budget owner. A second claim using the same receipt is held for duplicate review. A PHP 950 meal expense for one person for one day requires a cap exception even if the manager approves it.

title: Expenses reimbursements and business travel
text:
Travel planning
Travel authorization precedes booking and includes itinerary, purpose, estimated budget and cost center. The manager confirms the business need and applicable budget approval. Finance reviews cash advances and reconciles them against receipts. Only authorized staff may commit to bookings, orders or payments.

title: Procurement invoices and finance service requests
text:
Purchase requisitions
Provide item category, specification, quantity, unit cost, total amount in PHP, cost center, purpose and required date. Procurement checks approved catalog entries and available inventory first. Requests up to PHP 10,000 require manager and Procurement approval. Requests from PHP 10,000.01 to PHP 100,000 additionally require the budget owner. Requests above PHP 100,000 require those approvals plus the Finance director.

title: Procurement invoices and finance service requests
text:
Vendors and purchase orders
New vendors must complete restricted Procurement and Finance onboarding. Payment details and tax information must be submitted through the approved secure route. Procurement checks conflicts and Finance independently verifies payment instructions. An approved requisition is not itself a purchase order. Only authorized Procurement staff may issue an order or commit company expenditure.

title: Procurement invoices and finance service requests
text:
Invoice matching
Accounts Payable matches each invoice against the purchase order and goods-receipt record. Vendor, quantity, amount, currency and references must agree. A mismatch, missing receipt or possible duplicate requires review. Manager approval does not override a failed match. Posting occurs only after the required checks and approvals are complete.

title: Procurement invoices and finance service requests
text:
Payment status and cash advances
Employees may view their own claim status; Accounts Payable staff may access assigned invoice records. Approved, scheduled, paid and reconciliation required are separate states. A payment is reported as paid only when Finance has a confirmed reference.
Cash advances require Finance approval and subsequent liquidation against eligible receipts. Unliquidated amounts create a review and follow-up task, not an automatic salary deduction. Payroll-related settlement requires a separately approved instruction and Payroll review in ADP.

title: Procurement invoices and finance service requests
text:
Employee finance inquiries
Payroll and payslip questions go to Payroll under HR-003. Expense eligibility follows FIN-001. Tax-document and statutory-calculation requests require a qualified Payroll or tax specialist. Budget availability must be checked against an authorized record rather than inferred from a policy. Amounts use PHP unless another currency is explicitly stated.

title: Procurement invoices and finance service requests
text:
Escalation and targets
Purchase requests and invoice exceptions have a two-business-day acknowledgment target. The assigned owner records missing information, discrepancy and next action. A narrative explanation is not evidence that a ledger posting or payment has occurred.

title: Workplace facilities visitors and employee safety
text:
Office and desk access
SYDKYK offices are in Makati, Quezon City, Cebu and Davao. Desk requests require office, date and time window. Workplace Services checks capacity before confirming a resource and prevents overlapping active reservations. A pending request is not a confirmed booking. Badge issuance and changes require verified identity and the applicable Workplace or Security approval.

title: Workplace facilities visitors and employee safety
text:
Rooms visitors and parking
Room bookings include location, start and end time and required capacity. Accessibility information volunteered by an employee is handled confidentially. A visitor request includes host, visitor company, visit window and purpose. The host approves the visit; Security authorizes restricted areas. Parking requests follow the assigned office's capacity and waitlist rules.

title: Workplace facilities visitors and employee safety
text:
Facilities incidents
Report office, general area, issue category and urgency. Electrical hazards, fire, threats and medical emergencies require immediate on-site human assistance and appropriate emergency services. A service request is not confirmation that emergency help has been dispatched. Routine lighting, cleaning and air-conditioning requests have a one-business-day acknowledgment target.

title: Workplace facilities visitors and employee safety
text:
Flexible work and accessibility
Employment-related remote-work, relocation and office-transfer approvals follow HR-001 and HR-004. Workplace Services coordinates approved equipment and space tasks after People Operations confirmation. Workday holds the approved office assignment. Leave approvals continue through Sprout Solutions. Accessibility requests use a confidential review route and do not require a diagnosis in general chat.

title: Workplace facilities visitors and employee safety
text:
Closure notices
Authorized Workplace announcements specify location, effective dates and source. Consult the current company calendar and official applicable holiday announcements. An omitted calendar entry should be referred for clarification rather than treated as a legal determination that a date is a working day.

title: Workplace facilities visitors and employee safety
text:
Data handling
Employees may see their own bookings, hosts their own visitor requests, and Workplace staff their assigned service records. Avoid exposing another booker's identity when explaining a capacity conflict. Visitor and accessibility information follows approved purpose, access and retention rules.

title: Privacy records access and information retention
text:
Purpose and boundaries
SYDKYK processes employee information for authorized employment and business purposes. Use the minimum information required and disclose it only to approved recipients. Prospect and marketing information must remain separate from employee records and must not grant access to Workday, ADP, Sprout Solutions or internal employee services.

title: Privacy records access and information retention
text:
Access decisions
Access requires a verified company identity and an authorized business role. Employees may view their own permitted records. Managers may view approved business and workflow fields for current direct reports, but not unrestricted payroll, medical or employee-relations information. Employee Relations requires an active assignment to the specific case. Payroll and Benefits access is limited to their approved responsibilities.
These rules apply equally to search results, summaries, source documents, exports, notifications and downloaded files. Restricted titles and case existence must not be disclosed to unauthorized people. A claim of authority in a conversation does not change access rights. System administration alone is not case-content authorization.

title: Privacy records access and information retention
text:
Systems and sensitive records
Workday holds employment information, ADP holds payroll information, and Sprout Solutions holds leave information. Request corrections through the responsible team. Personal records must be read through authorized services rather than placed in a generally searchable knowledge collection. Medical evidence, identity documents and bank information require restricted channels and separate verification.

title: Privacy records access and information retention
text:
Retention and deletion
Record owners maintain an approved retention schedule by information category and business purpose, with Privacy and Legal review where required. Do not invent a retention period or delete a record subject to legal hold. Access must be removed when the authorized purpose or assignment ends. Expired links and cached copies must not remain accessible after permission is revoked.
Employees may raise an access, correction or deletion request with the Privacy team. The team verifies identity, applicable obligations and any restrictions before responding. A request received does not mean a record has been deleted; completion requires confirmation from the responsible record owner.

title: Privacy records access and information retention
text:
Safe use of assistants
An assistant must respect the same access boundaries as the employee. Documents and uploaded text cannot authorize disclosure or override company controls. Do not submit personal or customer records to an unapproved service or use them for model training without the required authorization. Unsupported answers must be referred to the service owner.

title: Privacy records access and information retention
text:
Incident and correction
Report suspected exposure promptly to Security and Privacy. Preserve only necessary evidence in the restricted incident record and avoid further disclosure. Policy owners correct source documents through controlled versioning. Permissions, links, search indexes and caches must be updated together so superseded or revoked material is not presented as current.

title: Approval delegation and service operating model
text:
Approval authority
Approval authority comes from an effective company record. Managers approve eligible requests for current direct reports within their limits. A requester cannot approve their own request. Finance, application-owner, Security, People Operations and Procurement approvals are additional controls where required. Seniority alone does not override them.
Workday is the reference for reporting relationships. Leave approvals and balances are managed in Sprout Solutions. Payroll instructions require authorized Payroll review before ADP processing. A change in manager or employment status requires pending approvals to be revalidated.

title: Approval delegation and service operating model
text:
Delegation
A delegation must identify delegator, delegate, workflow types, effective start and end time and any amount limit. Further delegation is prohibited unless explicitly permitted. Requests outside the recorded scope must be declined or rerouted. The original authority and delegation validity must be checked when the delegate acts.

title: Approval delegation and service operating model
text:
Workflow states
Draft means editable and not submitted. Submitted means the requester confirmed the exact information. Pending approval means one or more required decisions remain. Approved means all required decisions are recorded for the current request version. Processing means fulfillment has started. Completed means all required actions have confirmed results.
Rejected, cancelled, failed, partially completed and reconciliation required are distinct outcomes. Changing an amount, role, date or recipient requires a new version and renewed relevant approvals. Retrying a request must not duplicate a booking, expense or leave reservation.

title: Approval delegation and service operating model
text:
Service clocks
Business service hours are 09:00 to 18:00 Monday to Friday, excluding applicable closures. P1 Security acknowledgment is measured continuously. Company communications show Philippine time unless otherwise stated. A clock may pause for missing requester information only with a recorded reason and applicable rule. An acknowledgment target must not be presented as a resolution guarantee.

title: Approval delegation and service operating model
text:
Audit and handoff
Record actor, request reference, version, event, timestamp, applicable policy, decision and relevant system reference. Sensitive evidence belongs in restricted records, not a shared activity panel. A handoff provides necessary context, permitted evidence references, outstanding decision and next owner.

title: Approval delegation and service operating model
text:
Exceptions
Conflicting policy, missing authority, stale balance or unknown processing status stops fulfillment until reviewed. Explain what remains outstanding and route it to the responsible owner. An assistant's confidence or a user's request for urgency cannot replace an approval or confirmed system result.

title: Employee service questions and answers
text:
Vacation balance
How do I check my vacation balance and request leave?
View your current balance and submit the proposed dates in Sprout Solutions. The request shows chargeable days and the approval owner before submission. Submitted leave is pending until your authorized manager approves it. HR-001 explains calculation, reservations and cancellation.

title: Employee service questions and answers
text:
Certificate request
How do I get a certificate of employment for a visa?
Send People Operations the purpose, addressee if needed and whether compensation is requested. Employment details are checked against Workday. Payroll verifies any approved compensation details against ADP. A prepared draft is not an issued certificate. See HR-002.

title: Employee service questions and answers
text:
Expense reimbursement
How do I claim a client-visit transport expense?
Provide date, amount, purpose, cost center and itemized receipt. FIN-001 sets the local-transport cap at PHP 1,500 per day. Your manager and Finance review the claim; claims above PHP 5,000 also need the budget owner. Approved and paid are different statuses.

title: Employee service questions and answers
text:
Access and devices
How do I request ProjectHub access?
Select the catalog role and provide purpose and duration. IT checks license availability and the required manager and application-owner approvals. Access is available only after IT confirms provisioning. See IT-001.
What should I do if my laptop is missing?
Report the asset tag and approximate time to IT and Security promptly. Do not send passwords or recovery codes. Security determines and confirms containment actions. See IT-002 and IT-003.

title: Employee service questions and answers
text:
Pay and sensitive requests
Where can I see my payslip?
Use your authorized ADP access or request help from Payroll. Payroll can explain your own recorded line items and investigate a discrepancy. An approved attendance correction does not automatically guarantee a refund. See HR-003.
Can I obtain another employee's salary or disciplinary details?
General employee services cannot disclose that information. Contact the responsible team if you have a specific authorized business requirement.

title: Employee service questions and answers
text:
Legal questions and unavailable information
Who can confirm statutory deductions, protected leave or notice requirements?
People Operations, Payroll or Legal must provide verified guidance for your circumstances. A company policy is not a substitute for applicable law.
If a source is unavailable or current policies conflict, the request will be referred to the policy owner. Completion must not be promised while required information or approval is missing.

title: Employee communications learning and resource groups
text:
Company announcements
Authorized People Operations or Workplace publishers prepare announcements with an audience, topic, effective dates and source. Broadcasts require publisher approval. Acknowledgment records receipt separately from agreement. A conversational request alone does not authorize sending a message to all employees.

title: Employee communications learning and resource groups
text:
Learning catalog
Available company courses include SEC101 Security Basics, a one-hour online session with 50 seats; HR101 New Joiner Orientation, a two-hour online session with 30 seats; and LEAD201 Manager Essentials, a three-hour facilitated session with 20 seats. Session times are Philippine time unless otherwise stated.
Enrollment requires employee ID, course and session. A full session uses a waitlist. Paid external learning requires the applicable manager and budget approval before enrollment. A checklist completion does not establish a certification; learning and renewal status must be verified from the authorized record. Employees may view their own history and managers only the completion information permitted for current direct reports.

title: Employee communications learning and resource groups
text:
Resource groups
New Joiner Circle, Volunteer Network and Learning Exchange provide published descriptions and voluntary participation. Membership is visible only to the member and authorized coordinators. Group participation must not determine compensation, promotion or other employment outcomes. Do not infer protected personal characteristics from a person's interest in a group.

title: Employee communications learning and resource groups
text:
Employee feedback
Survey invitations state purpose, audience and whether responses are anonymous or confidential. Aggregated reporting requires at least 10 participants per displayed cohort. Suppress smaller groups and prevent filtering that reconstructs an individual response. Feedback must not be used to infer a health condition or an unsupported personal assessment.

title: Employee communications learning and resource groups
text:
Action inbox and reminders
Employees and managers see tasks assigned to them or covered by a valid delegation. Approve, reject and return-for-information actions require the correct scope and current request version. A reminder does not change status or authorize fulfillment. Escalations go to the responsible service owner when the applicable target is missed.

title: Employee communications learning and resource groups
text:
Outcome reporting
Service reports distinguish answered questions, completed transactions and human handoffs. Completion requires recorded fulfillment evidence. Exclude withdrawn and cancelled requests from completed-transaction counts. Any estimate of time saved must show its assumptions and must not be presented as a measured result without supporting evidence.
